lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdZn3 is tetragonal with space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143) and a unit cell containing 8 atoms (Nd2Zn6) distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives both Nd and Zn centers a 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangement, with Nd surrounded by 12 Zn and Zn by 4 Nd plus 8 Zn neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Nd–Zn and Zn–Zn 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
